holds.candidate: JAIC Data Dynamics / Digital Dynamic Fukushima Futaba Town Data Center
holds.reason: Eole’s November 25 first-party notice confirms the project is under construction and describes future completion and service dates. It identifies Futaba Town only. The exact host remains unpublished in the original source, as in the previous hold.
holds.reopen_condition: A new public original operator or planning record explicitly identifies the physical site.

holds.name: Lomé Data Centre, Togo
holds.progress: An October 30 account written by the facility describes ongoing operations. The ministry identifies the same commercial colocation establishment, opened in June 2021.
holds.hold_reason: The operator gives a district and a postal box. Its map embed is centred on a commercial map-provider point. The early World Bank report covers candidate sites; neither the postal box nor a planning alternative locates the completed campus.
holds.next_evidence_needed: A reusable civic or cadastral record for the named establishment, or a directly published operator location with independent provenance.

holds.name: Syntys 20 MW Qatar development
holds.progress: The operator reports a November 12 groundbreaking on one of its existing Qatar campuses.
holds.hold_reason: The announcement does not identify which of its four campuses hosts the new project. The 20 MW is planned capacity.
holds.next_evidence_needed: An operator or planning record that identifies the host campus.

holds.name: Rai Way Hyperscale Data Center, Pomezia
holds.progress: Rai Way announced planning permission in March. Its September 23 release explicitly confirms preliminary site preparation to clear the retired use. The November 11 nine-month results repeat the scope of those works, with commercial partner outreach ongoing. No evidence here of data-center building readiness or opening.
holds.hold_reason: The original project and reporting announcements locate the project in Pomezia without a facility-specific commercial civic address. The exact public campus identifier would need confirmation before mapping. A commercial-directory street number is insufficient.
